# Digital World AU (`https://digitalworldau.com/`)

> Australian Web Design, E-Commerce & Google Ads Conversion Agency — Sydney & Melbourne HQ (`hello@digitalworldau.com`).

## Core Services
- **Free 48-Hour Expert Website Audit**: UX friction review, mobile Core Web Vitals speed diagnostics, and Google SEO opportunities delivered within 48 hours (`https://digitalworldau.com/#contact`).
- **UI/UX & Bespoke Web Design**: High-contrast dark & editorial designs built mobile-first for conversion.
- **Custom Websites & E-Commerce Stores**: High-speed websites and D2C storefronts built with Astro 5, Svelte 5, Modular SCSS, Rust/WebAssembly, WordPress, Stripe, and Cloudflare Edge.
- **Google SEO & Paid Search CRO**: Local & national SEO, structured rich-result markup, and high-converting Google Ads landing pages.

## Transparent Pricing (Fixed-Scope Milestones)
- `€2,000 – €5,000` (`A$3,300 – A$8,250`): High-velocity conversion landing systems
- `€5,000 – €10,000` (`A$8,250 – A$16,500`): Custom business websites & multi-page brand sites
- `€10,000 – €20,000` (`A$16,500 – A$33,000`): High-converting e-commerce stores & portals
- `€20,000 – €50,000` (`A$33,000 – A$82,500`): Bespoke multi-region commerce flagships & web platforms
- **100% Client IP Ownership** upon milestone completion.

## Verified Live Production Portfolio
- **ANCHIALO Australia (`https://anchialo.com`)**: Australian D2C online store for certified Lake Pomorie Magnesium Gel & Oil dispatched from Melbourne.
- **CPT MMA Melbourne (`https://cptmma.com`)**: Coaching academy platform led by ONE Championship veteran Sotir Kichukov (`0.78s` mobile load).
- **AETERNA Digital Flagship (`https://aeterna.website`)**: Interactive 60fps 3D web platform achieving 100/100 Google PageSpeed metrics.
